Alex: Quick Q for people-ops: can full-time folks carry unused PTO into next year? We have several engineers hitting year-end crunch.
Maya (People Ops): Yes — company policy allows up to 80 hours (10 days) carryover for full-time employees. Part-time/capped-hour employees are prorated based on FTE. Anything above 80h requires manager + People Ops approval and for >120h we escalate to VP signoff.
Jules: How does proration work exactly for someone 0.5 FTE?
Olga (HR Systems): Its automated in the HRIS: FTE * 80h = allowed carryover. So 0.5 FTE -> 40h. If someones service started mid-year the system pro-rates their accruals and carryover allowance accordingly.
Alex: What about employees on parental leave or LOA — do they get an exception?
Maya (People Ops): For continuous leave (parental, medical) we treat accruals per the LOA policy. We can make one-time carryover exceptions for LOA cases, HR + manager review required. Documentation (LOA dates) must be attached to the carryover request.
Ben (Finance): A quick note on payroll: negative PTO balances for emergencies can be approved up to 24 hours by managers; anything beyond that needs People Ops + Payroll signoff and may be handled as unpaid time until accruals catch up.
Jules: Is there a deadline/process for submitting carryover requests?
Olga (HR Systems): Yes — submit a "Carryover Request" in Time Off (HRIS) by Jan 10. We take a system snapshot at 2024-12-31T00:00:00Z for balances. Approved carryover posts on Jan 12; unapproved balances above allowance will be reduced automatically on Jan 13.
Alex: Any blackout dates I should warn the team about?
Maya (People Ops): Company-wide production freeze/coverage window is Dec 20 00:00 through Dec 31 23:59 UTC. Core infra/product teams should limit planned time off during that period; managers may allow staggered rotations. Please add delegate approvers in HRIS if youll be OOO.
Jules: If a manager is OOO and there's an urgent carryover approval needed, who signs?
Olga (HR Systems): Managers can set an approval delegate in HRIS. If no delegate is set, People Ops will review and approve urgent carryover exceptions on a case-by-case basis.
Timekeeper Bot: Reminder: Carryover snapshot scheduled for 2024-12-31 00:00 UTC. Make sure time-off entries are accurate.
Alex: Great, thanks. I'll have the team check balances and submit by Jan 10.
